Chapter III · My letter

Dear Arunadevi,

Today, I don't just want to wish you a happy birthday. I want to thank you.

Thank you for the smiles, the conversations, the silly moments, the patience, the memories, and for simply being beside me. Life doesn't need to be perfect when I get to share it with you.

I hope the coming years give you every happiness you deserve. And when the next chapters arrive, I hope I'm still standing beside you, turning them into memories together.

Happy Birthday, my love. ❤️
Always yours,
Aravindhan
